test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following Hindustani classical instrumentalists won the Grammy Award in 1993 for his album ‘A Meeting by The River' with Ry Cooder?
solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**Vishwa Mohan Bhatt**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vishwa Mohan Bhatt**

 
 
• Legendary **Hindustani classical music instrumentalist Vishwa Mohan Bhatt**, also known as V. M. Bhatt **(born July 27, 1950)**, **plays the Mohan veena (slide guitar)**.
 
• The 67-year-old musician resides in **Rajasthan with his family**. 
 
• Bhatt is best known for the** Grammy Award-winning album 'A Meeting by the River with Ry Cooder**.
 
• Additionally, he has worked with **Western musicians including the Taj Mahal, Béla Fleck, and Jerry Douglas on other fusion and cross-cultural projects**.
 
• The Government of India honoured him in **2002 and 2017, with the Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan**, respectively.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A Meeting by The River**

 
 
• **Ry Cooder and Vishwa Mohan Bhatt** collaborated on the album '**A Meeting by the River,** which was **recorded in September 1992** and published in **April 1993 by the record label Water Lily Acoustics**.
 
• **Cooder plays slide guitar** on this spontaneous, group project album, and **Bhatt plays a stringed instrument he invented called the Mohan veena**.
 
• **Production, engineering, and mastering** for A Meeting by the River were handled by **Kavichandran Alexander, Jayant Shah, Alexander, Kevin Michael Gray, and Paul Stubblebine**. 
 
• On** Billboard's Top World Music Albums** list, it peaked at **position four**.
 
• The album is included in **Tom Moon's 2008 book 1,000 Recordings to Hear Before You Die**.
